items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She finally worked in a laboratory on 125th Street for Dr. Eccels, spent many years working there. I never saw my father...

ctx.x: Greensboro, North Carolina. My mother went to school there. She went to Bennett College. She came to New York with dreams of being a teacher, but when she got there, in those days it was very difficult for black people to be teachers in the public school system. She had a hard time. So she had to take a job, all kinds of jobs, even jobs as a – cleaning houses – a maid. She finally worked in a laboratory on 125th Street for Dr. Eccels, spent many years working there. I never saw my father, and I don’t know whether…
Did John McLean figure into your life at all?
